rung_purposes.purpose: Set motor overload alarm M191 when MOL-1001 (X13) trips.
Reset latched fault M190 when fault reset PB-0002 (X1) is pressed.
Set common fault M199 on latched fault M190, overload M191, or tripped E-stop X0.
Run conveyor motor M-1001 (Y10) in auto mode SS-0003 (X2) if no common fault M199.
Set pallet in position M100 when photo-eye PE-1001 (X10) detects pallet.
Latch stopper release solenoid XY-1004 (Y11) on release request RQ-1005 (X14) pulse.
Start 2.0 s timer T11 when stopper release solenoid XY-1004 (Y11) is energized.
Reset stopper release solenoid XY-1004 (Y11) when timer T11 completes.
